wm-drain-filter.snippet: If the machine completes a cycle but water remains, first clean the drain pump filter. A clogged filter is the most common cause of incomplete drainage on front-load washers.

wm-drain-hose.snippet: Ensure the drain hose is not kinked or pushed more than 10 cm into the standpipe. Restricted hoses cause slow or absent drainage without tripping a fault code.

wm-drain-pump.snippet: A continuous hum during the drain phase indicates the pump receives power but the impeller may be jammed by debris. Verify free rotation before replacing the pump.

generic-inspect.snippet: Begin every diagnosis by isolating power, then inspect the most accessible serviceable parts for blockages, wear, and loose connections before ordering replacement components.
